title_o: Effects of rumination and distraction on naturally occurring depressed mood

replications.quote: As hypothesized, visual analog scales and affective checklists for anxiety and negative mood overall were lessened more by distraction than rumination.

replications.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
replications.quote: the negative effects of the rumination condition were stronger among people relatively higher in baseline depression (compared to the distraction condition).
